messages:
incident-bot: :rotating_light: Automated page fired: p99 latency > 1.5s (eu-west) for /v1/generate. Trigger: p99_slo_eu_west. Pager: PagerDuty

incident-bot: pagerduty: Paged oncall 'dora-oncall' (priority: P1).

dora-oncall: acked. looking now. any customer-facing impact?

sam-sre: seeing elevated queue depth on sidecars in eu-west-2a, KV cache miss rate spiked ~10x. p95 creeping up too.

lia-support: two customers reported timeouts in support, tickets #4532 and #4533. both are on Dedicated capacity.

dora-oncall: thanks. sam, can you check sidecar memory + batcher backlog? I'll try a routing fallback to a lighter model.

sam-sre: checking logs — repeated OOMs and restarts around 2110009800. batcher backlog ~800 reqs, backlog growth rate ~ +200/s.

dora-oncall: temporarily routing new requests to fallback model variant (fast-quant) for eu-west via routing policy `prefer-fallback`.

oliver-pm: note on quality: fallback is lower latency but might trim long completions. will prepare a short customer note if this lasts >15m.

sam-sre: issuing scale-up for sidecar and batcher pools in eu-west; autoscaler applied +3 replicas. command: `kubectl scale deploy/sidecar-eu --replicas=9 -n inference-eu`

dora-oncall: routing change is live. initial signal: p99 dropped ~300ms within 30s of the reroute. monitoring dashboards: https://dashboards/redwood/p99/eu-west

lia-support: drafting status update: "We observed increased inference latency in eu-west; traffic has been temporarily routed to a lower-latency model while we scale infrastructure. We're monitoring closely."

mj-reliability: created post-incident ticket to adjust KV eviction thresholds and revisit OOM margin for sidecars.

dora-oncall: passing to next oncall at handoff time. staying until 2110009996. TL;DR: root cause - sidecar OOM -> backlog -> p99 burn. Mitigation - scale + fallback routing. RCA next steps: memory tuning, cache evictions, autoscaler config.

incident-bot: page acknowledged by dora-oncall, status: active -> mitigated. Duration: 10m. :white_check_mark:
